engines.label: DeepSeek · исходный DSP + наш адаптер алфавита
engines.adaptation: Native synthesis branches, explicit letter durations; new Ж/Щ recipes; Е/Ё/Ю/Я = й + vowel; no source edits.
engines.limitations: Voiced/unvoiced stop pairs are weakly distinguished in the source. Digits retain native removal of ь and я→а; no contextual palatalization.

provenance.waveform: Fresh mathematical source/filter synthesis; no previous WAV is an input.
provenance.DeepSeekAttribution: User-confirmed original formant_voice.py author; new alphabet adapter and Ж/Щ additions are ours.

comparison.durations: Alphabet uses the same requested segment durations; engines round samples differently. Digits retain native timings.
comparison.pronunciation: Consonants have no added э/а. Й is 80 ms. Е/Ё/Ю/Я use isolated initial й + vowel, not all contextual variants.
comparison.excludedRobot: The old phone robot exposes only zero/one/zerkalius; it is not presented as a complete alphabet.

status: Artifact production only; no tests, syntax checks, browser, playback or listening. Intelligibility is unverified.
